entities.summary: Anastasia Ailamaki is a professor of computer science at the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) in Switzerland, and the director of the Data-Intensive Applications and Systems (DIAS) lab. She is also the co-founder of RAW Labs SA, a Swiss company developing real-time analytics infrastructures for heterogeneous big data. Formerly, she was an associate professor of computer science at the Carnegie Mellon School of Computer Science.
